name: eng-ops
description: 건설현장 자료 비교와 가상 전화상담 초안 · mom-asked-ops 기반

scripts.build:site: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-public.mjs && node scripts/build-ops-web.mjs --enabled && node scripts/build.mjs --preserve
scripts.test: npm run build:legacy && npm run build:eng && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.check:site: npm run build:site && node scripts/check-site-build.mjs && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.site.jsonc --outdir .wrangler/site-bundle
scripts.build:legacy: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-public.mjs && node scripts/build-ops-web.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --preserve
scripts.check:eng: npm run build:eng && node --test tests/construction.test.mjs && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc --outdir .wrangler/eng-bundle
scripts.legacy:deploy:site: npm run build:site && node scripts/check-site-build.mjs && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.site.jsonc
scripts.legacy:migrate:worker:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply harmony-ops-staging --remote --config apps/ops-app/wrangler.staging.jsonc
